title: Simon 6.3.5–3.9: a current with an integral Lipschitz parametrization of finite total weight is integer multiplicity
statement: Let k, P ∈ ℕ and T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ (k + 1) on ℝ^P = Euclid P). For j ∈ ℕ let F_j : ℝ^{k+1} → ℝ^P be Lipschitz, A_j ⊆ ℝ^{k+1} Borel and g_j : ℝ^{k+1} → ℤ measurable with (g_j : ℝ) Lebesgue integrable on A_j. With DF(u) := fderiv ℝ F u, e_a := EuclideanSpace.single a 1, ∂F(u) := (DF(u)e_a)_{a ≤ k} and JF(u) := (det[⟨DF(u)e_a, DF(u)e_b⟩]_{a,b})^{1/2}, assume Σ_j ∫⁻_{A_j} |g_j(u)|·JF_j(u) du < ∞ and, for every test (k+1)-form ω, HasSum (j ↦ ∫_{A_j} g_j(u)·ω(F_j u)(∂F_j(u)) du) (T(ω)). Then T is integer multiplicity (IsIntegerMultiplicity T).
lean_statement: ∀ (k P : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1)) (F : ℕ → Euclid (k + 1) → Euclid P) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid (k + 1))) (g : ℕ → Euclid (k + 1) → ℤ), (∀ j, ∃ K : NNReal, LipschitzWith K (F j)) → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (A j)) → (∀ j, Measurable (g j)) → (∀ j, IntegrableOn (fun u => (g j u : ℝ)) (A j)) → ∑' j, ∫⁻ u in A j, ‖(g j u : ℝ)‖ₑ * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin (k + 1) => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (F j) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) (fderiv ℝ (F j) u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1))))) ≠ ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1), HasSum (fun j => ∫ u in A j, (g j u : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) (F j u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ (F j) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) (T ω)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T
